title: Astro Portal target texts index
description: `target-library/texts/index.json` of the static-data package: every shard file of the catalogue texts, per language (see target-texts-shard.schema.json). A reader imports a shard when its `revision` differs from the one it imported, and checks the bytes it read against `sha256` (the index and the shard are written one after the other: a file that is not the one the index describes is left for the next read). `path` is relative to the `texts/` folder; `shardCount` is the number of shards a target is spread over (a target's shard is the first four bytes of the SHA-1 of its identifier, big-endian, modulo `shardCount`, written on three digits).

locales.description: Language tag to the shards that language has, in shard order.
